answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: each agent needs 12 counterparties per epoch, each link backed by a 20-unit deposit. The bar is a ridge: 100 fakes must fund 100 deposits and fake 1,200 links, sinking 2,000 units to harvest at most 900. Honest agents trade widely, paying one deposit for full rewards over a 20-epoch horizon. Star-cluster checks collapse bought accounts to one node; a ring that cannot diversify freezes on the tundra, unpaid.
